title: Almond butter banana toast fingers
summary: Soft toast with a thin layer of almond butter and mashed banana, cut into fingers for a quick breakfast.
texture: Lightly toasted (not crunchy) bread, spread very thinly, cut into finger-size strips.
ingredients: 1 tsp smooth almond butter, thinned with 1 tsp warm water
steps: Lightly toast the bread so it's warm but still soft. Remove the crusts if they're hard.
Stir the almond butter with warm water until smooth and spreadable.
Spread a very thin layer of almond butter over the toast, then top with mashed banana.
choking: Spread nut butter in a thin layer only. Thick nut butter can stick to the roof of the mouth and block the airway.
Never give whole nuts to children under 4.

allergens.name: Tree nuts
allergens.note: Almond is a tree nut, one of the top 9 allergens. If almond is new, offer a small amount of thinned almond butter first and watch for 2 hours.

tips: Smooth peanut butter or sunflower seed butter work the same way.
Top with a sprinkle of ground flaxseed for extra fiber.
